title: Verithereum
tagline: This project has been created to provide users with attested Gilts
description: This project utilises a combination of attestations and proofs provided by EthSign and Witnet respectively so as to provide verifiable gilts that do not require vault inspections. The removal of vault inspections makes it easier for lending pools to validate and lend against the value of a given Gilt.
how_its_made: The project utilises Sign Protocol to provide attestation infrastructure. Witnet is used to create verifiable proofs of the attestations made, with Arbitrum Sepolia being the deployed network. The front end uses verified contracts and the block explorer to enable the creation of gilts, staking of gilts borrowing against gilts and liquidity provision. Verithereum leverages a monitoring UI that shows the verifications taking place
